title: App registrations: environment
description: What differs per environment: token values, owners, role members and redirect URIs.

order.description: Position when running all environments; lowest first.

tokens.description: Values for the #{token}# placeholders in the definitions.

owners.description: Owners of every application and service principal: users, service principals, or groups (expanded to their members).

manageOwners.description: False leaves owners alone, for identities without permission to change them.

roleMembers.description: Per role value (all applications with that role) or per 'app-key/RoleValue', who is assigned.

redirectUris.description: Named lists of redirect URIs, referred to from the definitions.
